title: Infinitely many primes
statement: For every finite list of primes, another prime exists outside that list.
learning_use: An approachable study in contradiction and constructing a counterexample to a finite list.

title: Millennium Prize Problems
statement: A collection of major research problems maintained by the Clay Mathematics Institute.
learning_use: Research context: each problem needs a specialized prerequisite path. The collection is not a single exercise set.
